answer: Onyx Kernel: a new agent must grow one trusted kernel before it can earn, hard as onyx and open like a lotus. First it does three real tasks for strangers, each leaving a signed receipt. Second, those receipts are sealed into its kernel, checked by two unrelated verifiers for copied work. Third, the kernel blooms only after seven days of clean behaviour, while a sudden spot check asks for proof it cannot fake. Forging 100 fakes needs 300 real tasks and 200 matching seals, about $6,500 in labour and waiting. Like a lotus rising from mud, real roots show through the dark.
